name: Billy Kelleher - § 43/1
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: ‘Stresses the need to improve the availability of, and access to, abortion throughout the EU; strongly supports the European Citizens’ Initiative entitled "My Voice, My Choice”, which aimed to set up a voluntary, solidarity-based, opt-in EU financial mechanism to ensure safe and accessible abortion in Europe; reiterates its call on the Commission to make full use of its competence in health policy to provide support to the Member States in guaranteeing universal access to SRHR,’
